question: Does ankle underfit improve through only stronger 2D weighting or more iterations?
fixed: same initial seed0, model/regressor, raw observations, priors, A30/B30/D100/D100, no added loss or smoothing
criterion: ankle aggregate mean and P95 pixel residual improve >=15%; other-joint mean worsens <=10%; raw-2D left/right ankle relative excursion amplitude discrepancy improves in both views; camera-space pelvis-relative ankle second-difference P95 grows <=20%
limits: 2D observations are model predictions, not truth; movement metrics are frame-indexed internal diagnostics, not validated gait or contact
stop: two single-variable runs only; nonfinite or source mismatch fails; record all failures; do not combine changes or expand search this round
next_selection: prefer the single parameter change that passes; no automatic mainline promotion
